lines.text: At dawn on the first day, the women went to the tomb, and an angel rolled away the stone.
The angel told the women that Jesus had risen and was going ahead of the disciples into Bethany.
Jesus met the women as they ran, and they grasped His feet and worshiped Him.
The chief priests met with the scribes, then paid the soldiers to say the disciples stole Jesus.
On the mountain, Jesus told the eleven to make disciples of all nations and promised to be with them always.
